actual_operator_comparison.hidden_pruning: Original two same-input UB1 half-hidden outputs including their frozen calibration/R256.
actual_operator_comparison.row_sharing: Original full-width FFN on one original input row; copy its pre-gate Y to the other while retaining each original residual stream. Existing recorded fullM teacher Y only; reducedM numeric identity is untested.
actual_operator_comparison.native_rounding_scope: BF16 CPU gate-product comparison on saved native Y. Complete x+gate*Y residual writeback and downstream are unmeasured.
actual_operator_comparison.signal: Saved post-Q1 input cosine is available before W1 but requires charging full-row Q1, similarity/layout and any policy cost. AUC is a descriptive rank statistic; no threshold/policy fitted.

limits: Known24 sources, sampled coordinates, oneblock/two middle steps. No new native pair execution, full graph coverage, strongest fixed spatial policy, action-specific downstream flow, video quality or FFN timing. This does not reopen D0 or authorize a model experiment.
